coastalGapFillMethod: Optional monthly-temperature coastal extrapolation: inverse-distance-squared weighting of up to four valid source centres within 2500 m; only water-grid points and water-clipped display use estimates. Original values stay null. No added observations.
method: Bilinear source interpolation with optional bounded coastal estimates as flagged per sample; currents interpolate u/v before magnitude and direction. No temporal filling.
